name: Corrosive Ichor
body:
Your blood has a corrosive effect on those that attack you.

Prerequisite: Kval, Character level 6.

Benefit: When an armed melee attack is successful against you, the weapon that struck you takes 1 point of damage that bypasses the hardness of non-magical weapons. Successful unarmed or natural melee attacks against you cause the attacker to take 1d3 points of damage.

Remarkable Races: Compendium of Unusual PC Races, Pathway to Adventure Edition. Copyright 2009, Alluria Publishing; Author: J. Matthew Kubisz
